zakoopt.option.frame_fence.tooltip: Replaces 7-8 GPU sync points per frame with one before the frame is presented. Big CPU win on NVIDIA; may not help when GPU-bound.
zakoopt.option.lazy_clear.tooltip: Skips redundant framebuffer switches after clears. Small effect.
zakoopt.option.no_entity_sort.tooltip: Skips sorting translucent player skin faces. Small CPU saving, nearly invisible.
zakoopt.option.item_lod.tooltip: Flat items (swords, tools) far away are drawn without their 1-pixel edge strips. Big help on mob farms. Measured: up to +30% FPS on a mob farm (26.2).
zakoopt.option.item_lod_distance.tooltip: Items closer than this are drawn in full. Use a larger value at high resolutions.
zakoopt.option.spawner_cull.tooltip: The spinning mob inside spawners is not drawn beyond the set distance. The cage stays.
zakoopt.option.spawner_distance.tooltip: Beyond this distance the mob inside a spawner is not drawn.
zakoopt.option.spawner_tick_cache.toolti: Rebuilds the spawner mob once per tick instead of every frame. Rotation stays smooth.
zakoopt.option.particle_light.tooltip: Particle light is computed once per tick. Same result, no visual change.
zakoopt.option.particle_physics.tooltip: Smoke, bubbles and distant particles skip block collisions. Smoke may pass through ceilings. Big stutter reduction on farms.
zakoopt.option.particle_lod.tooltip: Beyond 16 blocks every second particle is drawn, beyond 32 every fourth.
zakoopt.option.parallel_particles.toolti: Prepares particles on several cores when there are more than 1024. Only active on CPUs with 4+ threads.
zakoopt.option.gui_animated_items.toolti: Enchanted and animated items in the interface are redrawn at most at your monitor refresh rate instead of every frame.
zakoopt.option.bidi_cache.tooltip: Remembers name tag and scoreboard text layout instead of recomputing it every frame.
zakoopt.option.prepared_text_cache.toolt: Remembers prepared glyphs for name tags and the scoreboard. Makes name tags in crowds much cheaper.
zakoopt.option.moving_block_flat_light.t: Blocks moved by pistons are lit without smooth ambient occlusion while moving. Big help on piston farms, barely visible.
zakoopt.option.immediate_ring.tooltip: Entity, item and block vertex batches go into a persistently mapped ring buffer instead of re-uploading one buffer through the driver. It is slower on some systems (PCIe 3.0, no Resizable BAR), so 20 seconds into a world the mod compares FPS with and without it and keeps it only if it is faster.
zakoopt.option.block_entity_cache.toolti: Double chest neighbour lookup runs once per tick instead of every frame.
zakoopt.option.moving_block_cache.toolti: Piston-moved blocks are tesselated once and then only translated. One light value per block.
zakoopt.option.lookup_caches.tooltip: Block entity light once per tick, piston biome once, entity render types without extra hashing.
zakoopt.option.ring_zero_copy.tooltip: Opaque entities and blocks write vertices directly into GPU-visible memory, no copy before drawing.
zakoopt.option.spawner_replay.tooltip: Spawner mobs beyond 6 blocks turn 20 times a second and their draw calls are replayed from the tick cache.
zakoopt.option.micro_opts.tooltip: Sodium memory stack without a ThreadLocal per model cuboid, bubble water check once per block per tick.
zakoopt.option.hud_cache.tooltip: Hotbar, chat, scoreboard and the rest of the HUD are redrawn at the monitor refresh rate; frames in between reuse the last image. Crosshair and vignette stay live. Measured: +9% FPS at spawn.
zakoopt.option.skin_atlas.tooltip: Player skins are packed into one texture so all players are drawn in one call instead of one per player.
zakoopt.option.writer_cache.tooltip: Sodium checks the buffer for its fast path once per model instead of once per cuboid.
zakoopt.option.outline_skip.tooltip: The glowing-entity outline buffer is neither cleared nor blended over the frame when nothing glows.
zakoopt.option.fbo_share.tooltip: Render passes and Sodium draw into the same framebuffer object instead of switching between two identical ones.
zakoopt.option.sign_cache.tooltip: Sign model, material and texture and the block entity type check come from a cache instead of being looked up every frame.
zakoopt.option.entity_lod.tooltip: Beyond the set distance mobs and players skip armour, held items, eyes, capes and the outer skin layer. Measured: +7% FPS at spawn at 35 blocks, +9% at 24.
zakoopt.option.entity_lod_distance.toolt: Distance (in blocks) from which mobs and players are simplified.
zakoopt.option.player_lod.tooltip: Apply entity LOD to players too: far away they lose the outer skin layer, cape, armour and held items. Turn off to keep players fully detailed while mobs are still simplified.
zakoopt.option.all.tooltip: Turns all recommended optimizations on or off at once. Options that are off by default (such as animation freeze) are left alone.
zakoopt.group.author: Author
zakoopt.option.channel.tooltip: Mod news, benchmarks and new builds first. Subscribe to the author: t.me/StarikZako
zakoopt.option.hud_cache.foreign: Disabled automatically: AxolotlClient or Exordium render the HUD their own way, and together with this cache it would flicker.
zakoopt.option.entity_anim_freeze.toolti: Beyond the set distance mobs and players update their pose 20 times a second instead of every frame; movement stays smooth. Big win on mob farms, but far mobs animate choppily. Measured: +6% FPS on a mob farm at 16 blocks, +14% at 8.
zakoopt.option.entity_anim_distance.tool: Distance (in blocks) from which mobs and players update their pose once per tick.
zakoopt.option.update_check.tooltip: Once per launch, when the title screen opens, asks GitHub for the latest mod version and shows a dialog if a newer one is out. Sends nothing about you. Off means no requests at all.
